{{Quote|Greetings, cousin. Aunt Chelik must be desperate for the throne if she is willing to sacrifice her own daughter to get it.|Tenel Ka Djo|<ref name="Dark Journey" />}}
'''Chelik's daughter''' was a [[Prince/Legends|princess]] of the [[Hapan Royal House]], the daughter of [[Chelik]] and great-niece of the [[Queen Mother]] [[Ta'a Chume]].<ref name="Dark Journey" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], she attempted to [[assassin]]ate her [[cousin]] [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Isolder]] as he returned to the [[Fountain Palace]]. Her attempt was foiled by Isolder's daughter, the [[Chume'da]] [[Tenel Ka Djo]], and she was led away by the guard [[Ubris]].<ref name="Dark Journey" />

Although Tenel Ka's first thought was that Chelik was behind the assassination attempt, she decided on reflection that the girl had more likely been put up to the act by her scheming aunt [[Alyssia]], and that the attempt had been intended to fail, in order to weaken Chelik and strengthen Alyssia's own ambitions to seize the throne.<ref name="Dark Journey" />

Tenel Ka calmly assumed that her cousin would be promptly executed for her action.<ref name="Dark Journey" />
